# Underwriting Memo

**Risk summary**

Elsmere Inns operates select-service hotels near business districts in San Antonio and Houston, TX. The account presents $5.79M TIV across three locations. Brindlecove Risk Services (Core broker) submitted this HOTL-classified risk with a fit score of 60.1. All locations are inland (68-206 km from coast). The Houston location sits within a $317M portfolio concentration zone.

**Appetite and referral**

This submission requires senior underwriter referral per **AG-007** (HOTL class mandatory referral, max $30M TIV). The account triggers two appetite concerns: class referral requirement and five-year incurred losses exceeding $250K threshold. **AG-014** confirms inland Texas locations align with territorial appetite. **AG-007** requires review of fire protection, housekeeping standards, and loss history before quoting.

**Loss history**

Five-year incurred losses total $253.8K across seven claims. Wind damage to roofs occurred in 2021 ($137.8K) and 2022 ($33.4K). Recent claims include 2024 slip-and-fall ($61.1K) and 2025 theft ($21.5K). No claims reported in 2023. No open claims currently.

**Exposure and concentration**

Houston location adds $1.04M TIV to existing $317M portfolio concentration within 25km. San Antonio locations contribute to $56.8M local accumulation.

**Recommendation**

Suggest referral to senior underwriter with request for: roof condition reports, fire protection details, housekeeping protocols, and slip-and-fall prevention measures.
